This Writ Petition was filed seeking the following relief:
"...to issue a Writ of Mandamus or any other appropriate Writ, Order or direction declaring the action of respondent No.4 in registering the FIR No.278 of 2020 of Bhimavaram I Town Police Station, as illegal, contrary to the directions of the provisions of law and consequently direct respondent No.4 to register an FIR by implementing the Order dated 01.02.2021 in SR No.3777 of 2020 passed by the learned II Additional Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Bhiamvaram to sub-serve the cause of justice and to pass such other order..."

sentences.text: Later, the respondents-police called the Writ Petitioner on different occasions and forced her to settle the dispute.

Later, the Writ Petitioner filed a complaint, vide S.R.No.3337 of 2020 before the II Additional Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Bhimavaram, and the said Court, vide Order dated 01.02.2021 directed the police concerned to register an FIR.

entities.text: II Additional Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Bhimavaram
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: On 01.03.2021 respondent No.4-Police filed memo before the SRK, J Jurisdictional Court stating that already FIR in Crime No.278 of 2020 was registered on 16.09.2020.
It is the contention of Writ Petitioner that the case in FIR No.278 of 2020 was registered without her knowledge and without following her directions.
Hence, the Writ Petition.

3. When the matter has come up for hearing, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home, on written instructions, submits that the Writ Petitioner lodged a complaint on 16.09.2020 alleging that her brother cheated her by obtaining her signature on the false pretext of a loan and by executing a Partition Deed dated 17.12.2015.
The complaint was registered as a case in Crime No.278 of 2020 of Bhimavaram I Town Police Station.

During investigation, it revealed that the Writ Petitioner, having received her share amount of Rs.2,50,000/- and having given consent voluntarily, with an intention to claim enhanced share and to exert pressure on the brother for monetary gain, got foisted false case.
Accordingly, the respondents- police referred the case as False vide C.No.840/SDPO-N/2021, dated 26.11.2021.
4. In view of the fact that on the self-same allegations the said crime was registered and it was referred as False, no orders are required to be passed in the present Writ Petition.
SRK, J 5.
Accordingly, the Writ Petition is closed.
It is needless to mention that if the Writ Petitioner is aggrieved by the same, she is at liberty to avail the remedies in accordance with law.
There shall be no order as to costs of the Writ Petition.
As a sequel thereto, the miscellaneous applications, if any, pending in this Writ Petition, shall stand closed.
JUSTICE K. SREENIVASA REDDY 31st March, 2026.
